historical_references.reference: Khusaib ibn Al-Harith Al-Ansari was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad and participated in many battles. One of his most notable contributions was his role in the Battle of Khaybar in 628 AD. During this battle, Khusaib led the Muslim forces against the Jewish tribes of Khaybar, ultimately resulting in the conquest of the fortress and the conversion of many Jewish inhabitants to Islam.

historical_references.reference: Khusaib ibn Al-Asyad is mentioned in the Islamic tradition as a companion of the Prophet Muhammad and a participant in the Battle of Uhud in 625 AD. During this battle, Khusaib was one of the few Muslims who managed to hold the Muslim right flank against the advancing enemy, allowing the Muslim forces to regroup and eventually repel the invading Meccan army.
